name: Granville Stuart
role: President of the Montana Stock-Growers' Association
bio: Granville Stuart was elected president of the Montana Stock-Growers' Association in July 1884, and that August his cowboys were reported to have a band of horse thieves surrounded near the mouth of the Musselshell. In September 1885 the paper praised his Helena resolution as a friend of the cowboy. In November 1885 he passed through Medora on his way to the national association meeting, and that December the paper listed him as Montana's vice-president of the National cattle and horse-growers' association.
